subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped now to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving prompt-driven channel-selective replies to a separate delivery/API design?
rationale: The source-confirmed command prompt gap is narrow, but letting prompts or rules choose delivery channels would change channel/message routing policy and may affect plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, chat type, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

options.title: Split Routing Design
options.body: Track channel-selective replies in a separate maintainer-approved product/API issue before changing delivery behavior.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Keep delivery host-controlled and close the broader routing portion once the metadata parity gap is fixed or explicitly documented.

recommendation.title: Scope To Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, chat type, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history on the shared command prompt bundle and already provided the clearest scoping guidance on the issue.
